hindi_voice_text: व्रत लिया, महाराज। अब इसे निभाइए।
english_voice_text: The vow is taken, Maharaj. Now keep it.
hinglish_screen_text: Vrat liya, Maharaj. Ab ise nibhaiye.

hindi_voice_text: एक व्रत, एक शब्द। मैदान गवाह है।
english_voice_text: One vow, one word. The field is witness.
hinglish_screen_text: Ek vrat, ek shabd. Maidan gawah hai.

english_voice_text: The vow held, Maharaj. The honour is yours.
You gave your word, and you kept it.

hindi_voice_text: व्रत टूटा, महाराज। फिर भी मैदान आपका।
english_voice_text: The vow broke, Maharaj. The field is still yours.
hinglish_screen_text: Vrat toota, Maharaj. Phir bhi maidan aapka.

hindi_voice_text: वचन छूट गया। अगली बार सँभालिए।
english_voice_text: The word slipped. Hold it next time.
hinglish_screen_text: Vachan chhoot gaya. Agli baar sambhaliye.

hindi_voice_text: भीम डटा रहा — रास्ता खुल गया।
english_voice_text: Bhima held his ground, and the road opened.
hinglish_screen_text: Bhima data raha — raasta khul gaya.

hindi_voice_text: भीम के आगे बराबरी का वार नहीं टिकता।
english_voice_text: Against Bhima, an equal blow does not stand.
hinglish_screen_text: Bhima ke aage baraabari ka vaar nahi tikta.

hindi_voice_text: कर्ण का कवच टूटा, पर वह खड़ा रहा।
english_voice_text: Karna's armour broke, but he stood.
hinglish_screen_text: Karna ka kavach toota, par woh khada raha.

hindi_voice_text: कर्ण ने एक और मौक़ा ले लिया।
english_voice_text: Karna bought himself one more chance.
hinglish_screen_text: Karna ne ek aur mauka le liya.

hindi_voice_text: रात में घटोत्कच का बल बढ़ता है।
hinglish_screen_text: Raat mein Ghatotkacha ka bal badhta hai.

hindi_voice_text: अंधेरे में घटोत्कच का पलड़ा भारी।
english_voice_text: In the dark, Ghatotkacha has the weight.
hinglish_screen_text: Andhere mein Ghatotkacha ka palda bhaari.

hindi_voice_text: द्वार टूटा — धृष्टद्युम्न ने शक्ति दी।
english_voice_text: The gate is broken. Dhrishtadyumna adds Shakti.
hinglish_screen_text: Dwaar toota — Dhrishtadyumna ne shakti di.

hindi_voice_text: धृष्टद्युम्न का रास्ता खुला। सेना आगे बढ़े।
english_voice_text: Dhrishtadyumna opened the way. Bring the army through.
hinglish_screen_text: Dhrishtadyumna ka raasta khula. Sena aage badhe.
